title: Project Vastra - Distribution of Sarees.
summary: Project with purpose 26 sarees. significance of 26 in 2026 year.
description:
Project with purpose 26 sarees.
significance of 26 in 2026 year.

Dear Rotary Family,

I am delighted to share that on the auspicious occasion of *Vasubaras 2026*, our club member *Rtn. Meenakshi Aman* has taken up a noble initiative of *Saree Donation Drive* for the poor families of *Palghar District, Vasai Taluka.*

Today, *26 sarees were distributed* to needy beneficiaries.

This is not just distribution of sarees, it is *sharing and caring*. A good saree can bring colourful, happy thoughts and help them celebrate Diwali with dignity and joy.

As President, I wholeheartedly thank *Rtn. Meenakshi Aman* for doing this project at the right time and leading it with compassion. Her commitment truly reflects Rotary's motto - *Service Above Self.*

Warm Regards,

*Rtn. Rajesh Sahu*
President - 2026

*Rtn. Sameer Choudhary*
Secretary - 2026

*Rtn. Samir Srimankar*
Treasurer - 2026

*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli*
